specs.Compatible Devices: Laptop, MP3 Player, Smartphone, Tablet, Television

features: [Powerful Output]: The ZEB-Vita 102, with its 16W RMS output, delivers a powerful, room-filling sound, perfect for parties, gatherings, or personal use.
[Dual Passive Radiators]: The ZEB-Vita 102 features dual passive radiators and dual drivers for enhanced bass and balanced, rich audio output.
[Multi-connectivity]: The ZEB-Vita 102 offers versatile connectivity with BT v5.3 for seamless wireless pairing and mSD, USB, and AUX inputs for flexible audio source options.
[Dual Drivers]: The ZEB-Vita 102's dual 52mm drivers deliver clear, dynamic sound with precise, immersive audio across a wide frequency range.

[Longer playtime]: The ZEB-Vita 102 features a built-in rechargeable battery with up to 8* hours(* at 50% volume, LED Off) of playback and convenient Type-C charging, ensuring your music plays throughout the day.
